entries.zh: 蚝壳灰：牡蛎壳烧制的石灰，供嚼槟榔蘸用，亦作砌筑灰浆
entries.en: oyster-shell lime (cal del othion); lime for betel-quid chewing, also building mortar
entries.notes: 西栏 caldo del buyc 与 quando/quamdo 均有[疑]，疑为 cal del buyo（槟榔灰）之讹；汉字蠔/蠓亦存疑，据 M ō-cag-húe 与汉字栏西注 Cal del othion 定为蚝壳灰。

entries.zh: 泡饭：米加汤水泡煮成的软饭；汤泡饭
entries.en: soft boiled rice in broth; soaked rice (arroz morisqueto)
entries.notes: 汉字'泡'与末字（閻/閹）有[疑]；西栏 morisquera 疑即 arroz morisqueto（汤煮软饭），与'泡飯'及 M pān-pay 相合。

entries.zh: 豆油：酱油；豆汁、豉汁之类的咸豆露
entries.en: soy sauce; salty bean sauce or liquor (caldo de frisoles salado)
entries.notes: 官话栏 tēn iēn 与'豆油'对音不合，据汉字荳油、闽南 tǎu iū 与西语'咸豆汁'三栏定为酱油。

entries.zh: 历：历法、历书
entries.en: calendar; almanac

entries.zh: 历日：历书、日历；一年的历日
entries.en: annual calendar; almanac, calendrical days

entries.zh: 燥：干热、燥热（中医六淫之一，热而干燥）；使干燥、烘燥
entries.en: hot and dry; parched; to dry, to scorch

entries.zh: 燥热：干热、燥热之性（热而干燥）
entries.en: dry heat; hot and dry (quality)

entries.zh: 灼：烧灼、炙烤；（烤火）暖身
entries.en: to scorch, burn; to warm oneself by fire

entries.zh: 灼烧：烤火取暖；烧灼
entries.en: to warm oneself at the fire; to burn, scorch

entries.zh: 灼火：烤火取暖
entries.en: to warm oneself by the fire

entries.zh: 热：热、炎热；烫热如火
entries.en: hot, burning hot; heat

entries.zh: 热火：火热、滚烫如火
entries.en: hot as fire; glowing hot

entries.zh: 炒：炒、翻炒加热；焙烤
entries.en: to stir-fry, pan-heat; to toast, roast

entries.zh: 炒过：已炒过、炒制过的；炒焙（如炒辣椒）
entries.en: to toast (peppers); stir-fried, toasted (done)
entries.notes: 西栏 piambres 无[疑]标记，按 17 世纪拼写姑读作 pimientos（辣椒，经马尼拉传入）；'炒過'本义据四栏（kuè/过）自明。

entries.zh: 炒烧：炒焙、翻炒兼烧灼
entries.en: to stir-fry and scorch; heat and toast over fire

entries.zh: 烘：烘烤、烘暖（在炭火余烬上加热）
entries.en: to warm, bake over embers (al rescoldo), by the fire
entries.notes: 闽南栏首音调符污损（T99）且 M 栏夹残句（hay mano:）；据 hang、官话 hòng 与西语 rescoldo 仍定为'烘'义，置信从低。

entries.zh: 烘火：烤火、烘火取暖
entries.en: to warm oneself at the embers/fire
entries.notes: 闽南栏首音调符污损（T99）；据 hang-hué 与官话 hòng hò 仍定为'烘火'，置信从低。

entries.zh: 放水：把水放（到火上）烧热；原义放水、倒水
entries.en: to put water on (to heat); to heat water
entries.notes: 西语 calentar agua 与汉字'放水'对举：传教士记'放水'为烧水之说法，M 栏附 al agua 与互见号 103。

entries.zh: 煎药：熬药、煎煮汤药
entries.en: to boil, brew medicine; medicinal decoction
entries.notes: 闽南栏 fim 与'煎'对音不合（官话 chīn yò、汉字煎藥相合），据三栏定为煎药。

entries.zh: 温烧：文火温热、焐暖（烤火或在被窝里取暖）
entries.en: to warm gently at the fire or in bed
